description: Write-time tool-result compaction: placeholder-izes oversized tool outputs in the session JSONL while preserving JSON structure, parent links, and recent-turn protection (COMPACTION_FEATURE.md Phase 1). Enable with plugins.slots.memory: "context-pruner" (kind: memory plugins are gated by the memory slot).

enabled.description: Master switch for this plugin only: write-time tool-result placeholder-ization, the 50k safety cap, the background Historian/eviction wiring, and deferred audio transcription. Independent of agents.defaults.compaction.enabled (set that false to stop kernel compaction too).

model.description: Groq Whisper model used after the delay window.

delayMinutes.description: Minimum age in minutes before an untranscribed audio attachment is sent to STT.

stt.description: Fail-open deferred audio transcription settings. GROQ_API_KEY is read from Gateway env or process environment.

keepLastAssistants.description: Number of most-recent assistant speeches whose tool results are kept raw (assistant-boundary protection).

minPrunableToolChars.description: Tool results shorter than this many characters are never placeholder-ized.

defaultPreserve.description: When true, keep raw tool output by default (Phase 2 will add per-call preserve: true override).

placeholder.description: Optional custom placeholder text. Defaults to the canonical format [出力省略: {行数}行 / {サイズ} 正常終了].

protectedContentKeywords.description: Tool results containing any of these keywords (case-insensitive) are never pruned (e.g. config paths like AGENTS.md / SOUL.md).
